headline: Kraken’s Jared McCann to miss game against Wild with injury
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Seattle forward Jared McCann will miss the game against the Wild with an injury. Alison Lukan, a Kraken contributor, posted that he is being evaluated for a lower-body injury and that the team has recalled forward Jani Nyman from Coachella Valley.

The Kraken can feel this one. So far this season SEA has controlled just 46.6 percent of expected goals (a measure of the quality of chances), and 45 percent at five-on-five, yet sits 7-3-1. McCann is a small bright spot in that picture: with him on the ice, the team's expected-goal share is 4.5 percentage points better than without him. He has three goals against roughly 4.5 expected, so his scoring is running a bit cold, not hot, and the underlying play suggests it should come back.

No games have been missed yet, so the minutes projection goes by how the coach has used his players. Berkly Catton (14:22 a night) is next in line for McCann's second-line minutes, and Bobby McMann, the busiest man on the second power-play unit, is the likeliest to move up to the first unit.
